allocatePortfolio.note: FC7 slice 4 (Stage 4.4, 2026-08-29): target weights to executable quantities: resolves the policy's targets at an explicit asOf through the ONE expansion law, sizes against explicit prices (FC5 conversion for non-base instruments), rounds toward zero to lot sizes, skips dust below the minimum notional, honours a cash reserve and the cash target, estimates commission/spread/slippage, and reports every unresolved goal, rounding residual, and funding shortfall explicitly — nothing is scaled silently

applyJournalEvents.note: Stage 7B.2 slice 2 (AT5, 2026-09-05): Decision 6 — the execution journal folded to per-order states with the transition table enforced; a late fill leaves the order unresolved, a duplicate delivery is recorded once

applyPortfolioEvents.note: FC7 first slice (Stage 4.4, 2026-08-28): the direct pure reducer — portfolio truth is a fold over immutable economic events (agent-native Law 1). Classified ARTIFACT, not facade: it returns a deeply-frozen, schema-versioned state object (the artifact grammar), carries no assumptions/diagnostics by design (Law 2 — P&L and valuation are derived reports from portfolioSnapshot/portfolioTimeline), and a .explain twin would explain a state, not a number.
